notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
Dear friends! Today we are releasing patch 1.3
1.Improved the handling of the car.
2. Replaced the animation of the character when driving a car.
3. Removed the Sim's duplicate on the Wolfhound map. (After downloading)
4.After the timer ends, it automatically picks us up.
5. Improved the balance of bots.
6. The ultrasound was removed.
7. Fixed some collisions
8. Fixed the final Milk fight. Now it's harder to get him.
9. Improved cutscenes in the final.
[b]IMPORTANT
Sometimes, the game may not save your game. Such saves have the designation 1/01/01 - 00:00
We are working on fixing this problem! The game can be completed the first time, if you make an effort) Thank you!
[/b]

notes.title: SECOND DAY PATCH, VERSION 1.2 + ACHIEVEMENTS
notes.content:
Greetings players!
We are releasing the second patch, in which we have made the following changes:

1. finally removed the duplicates of our helpers. Previously, if you pick up a helper appeared his double.
2. Added 7 achievements for each boss of the game.
3. Other minor fixes and improvements.

[b]In the demo version of our game for 1 year played more than 19 thousand people. We hope that not less people will play the full version.[/b]

notes.title: FIRST DAY PATCH, version 1.1
notes.content:
Greetings to our players!
A lot of work has been done today on the first day patch, namely:

1. Removed duplicate characters, but sometimes a copy of a helper may appear after you pick it up.
2. Added a cat. scene on the bridge on the final map.
3. Increased the volume of some of the dialog.
4. Changed the font in the notes and now it is more readable.
5. Added the ability to load the game from the save slot.
6. Added checkpoints with automatic saves before each boss battle.
7. Added the ability to switch the shader to SM5 and by default it is it is enabled and needed for AMD graphics cards to avoid artifacts.
8. Fixed the final scene and now the game can be fully passed. But in the final scene you will not be easy.
9. Introduced edits to the balance of some maps (removed part of the bots, part of the bots reduced HP and damage).
10. And other small changes and improvements.

[b]We pay attention to all your feedback and all videos and make adjustments to the game, if they are required and hope for your activity.[/b]

notes.title: Unnatural events or unlocking the game
notes.content:
After a long trial (10 working days), the game was unlocked since Warner Bros. did not provide any evidence of copyright infringement.

But we still renamed the game Unnatural: Benighted, so that there would be no more provocations on their part and continue to develop it. [b] And also remove some similarities from the game.[/b]

[h2]And we would be very happy if you could help us spread this news.[/h2]

notes.title: Appeal to the players
notes.content:
Hello, our dear players.
We are very pleased to see that our game is being played. We want to thank each of you for your feedback. He will be very useful to us.

[b]We want to explain to you our position on the game.[/b]
[i]1. A full-fledged game will have more investigations and adventures.
2. Reduced boss fight. An increase in the number of rounds and damage to bots (possible).
3. The following missions will be diluted with horror, investigation, etc.
4. Many of you scolded us for the voice acting. They asked us to hire voice actors. We can't do that, we've invested heavily in the game and our time. Reworking voice acting/ordering voice acting is very expensive for us, we can't afford it.
5. Subtitles will be added to all videos. In addition to those that are already available.
Thank you all for participating in our project. I hope you will be with us at the release.[/i]
